description.narrative:
This investment has been created to support disbursement of an allocation of AUD500,000 from the Humanitarian Emergency Fund (HEF) to the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) to support the Armenia Refugee Response Plan.
An escalation, on 19 September 2023, in a decades long conflict in the disputed Nagorno-Karabakh region saw displacement of primarily ethnic Armenians in the region into Armenia. The Government of Armenia reported that between 24 September and 4 October 2023, 100,632 refugees, including 30,000 children, arrived in the country. The number of refugees constitutes almost 3 per cent of the Armenian population and adds to the 36,000 refugees, asylum-seekers and stateless people of all nationalities who were already present in the country.
The Armenia Refugee Response Plan sets out the response strategy for humanitarian partners – complementary to the Government’s response – to meet the needs of 101,000 refugees and a host population of 95,000.
